name: Obsidian
what: Obsidian says it collects no telemetry. The desktop app contacts Obsidian to check for and download updates. The Automatic updates switch is stored as "updateDisabled": true in obsidian.json (read from the shipped app, which is closed source). Users report that some update traffic can continue with the switch off. Community plugins are out of scope.

steps: Settings > General: turn off Automatic updates. Obsidian then writes "updateDisabled": true to obsidian.json.
